page.layout: One text block on a single printed page. At the top, a centred title in several lines under an ornamental border. Below it, one verse passage, left-aligned, opening with a decorated initial. The signature mark stands at the right after the last line. Page number at the top right. No running head.

main_text.head: MARTINO MARLOREO, BARRENSI CAVSIDICO, impuro Apostatae, Euangeli-cae veritatis persecutori acerrimo, EPITAPHIVM I. I. B. posuit.

p.i: T[?]ANDEM Causidicum tacere Parca Iussit Marloreum bonis benigna, Quos Barri prius impotente lingua, Et gannitibus impiis, profanis, Impurus canis allatravit usque. Quos furens odio Vatiniano, Fictis criminibus, calumniisque, Longis vociferationibusque Vexavit Sycophanta turbulentus, Inquietior Adria inquieto, Infanis violentior procellis, Thracio Diomede, vel Cyclope Humani sitientior cruoris, Poenis perfidior dolosiorque, Et Thrasone superbior Terenti[?], Iracundior invido Catello, Interdum quoque blandior Catella, Vel risu meretricis exoleta.

page.notes: The title line "impuro" is struck through by a horizontal line in the print; it is kept here as printed. The decorated initial is taken to be T, but this is uncertain. "Terenti" is printed "Terentl" and may be a misprint. "impijs" is printed with j after i and is spelled as the vowel i here. The signature mark at the right is read as "M. j." and is uncertain.
